info.description: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.4+ microservices monorepo — one folder per service, each with its business endpoints plus Actuator and (pending) Metrics subfolders. Import once; folders for not-yet-built capabilities are pre-scaffolded so this collection doesn't need re-importing as later milestones land.

item.name: Auth Service

request.description: Creates a credential (BCrypt-hashed). 409-worthy duplicate email currently surfaces as a generic 500 — the global exception handler arrives at Milestone 7.
Login/JWT issuance isn't built yet — that's Milestone 6.
Milestone 6: authenticates against Credential and mints a fresh access/refresh token pair.

Milestone 6: rotates a still-valid refresh token for a new pair; rejects an already-rotated-out token. When called through the API Gateway instead, the refresh token is read from the spendwise_refresh_token cookie, not this body field.

Milestone 4: register + get-by-id only. Login/JWT/refresh arrive at Milestone 6.

request.description: Milestone 6: routed through api-gateway's auth-service-issuance route. The Gateway strips refreshToken out of this response and sets it as an HttpOnly spendwise_refresh_token cookie instead.
Milestone 6: routed through api-gateway's auth-service-issuance route; same cookie-rotation behavior as Register.

Milestone 6: routed through api-gateway's auth-service-refresh route. Send with no body — the Gateway reads the refresh token from the spendwise_refresh_token cookie (set by a prior Register/Login through the Gateway) and injects it into the request it forwards to auth-service, then rotates the cookie again on the response.

Milestone 6: JWT-protected passthrough to user-service. Requires {{accessToken}} (captured automatically by the Auth (via Gateway) requests) — the Gateway validates it, then forwards a signed X-User-Context header that user-service trusts instead of re-validating the JWT.
Milestone 6: JWT-protected passthrough to transaction-service via the Gateway.
Milestone 6: JWT-protected passthrough to budget-service via the Gateway.
